mentions.indieAngle: Pick one WFM wedge for PL/EU deskless niches that still live in Excel + WhatsApp — cleaning crews, facility maintenance, or restaurant multi-site — and sell schedule + timesheet + simple compliance docs at €8–€15/seat. Don't try to out-build UKG; own one vertical's onboarding and payroll-export formats.

whyItPrints: Workforce management is the textbook boring vertical — schedules, time tracking, compliance paperwork for deskless teams. ~$243k MRR with 2,505 seats implies a mid-market / SMB seat product that compounds for years (my inference from MRR ÷ subs ≈ $97/mo average — my calculation). L30 cash is lumpy (−71.6%) while MRR is almost flat (−3.1%), which is what multi-year / annual SaaS often looks like on a 30-day cash window.
